2893-3470-6168-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2459-2921-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-2921-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

2645-3861-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Orzhov Basilica's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{B}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

1865-2232-7827-7830.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
1865-2232-7827-7830.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-3504.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-3504.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-3504.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-4478-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-4478-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

1402-2921-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

4038-5832-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Joraga Treespeaker's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-3499.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1298-2034-6738.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {3}.
Ovika triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens that gain haste until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Phyrexian Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Razor Boomerang's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to a Phyrexian Goblin.
Activate the Phyrexian Goblin by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Goblins, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1298-2034-6738.notes: You can forego sacrificing Phyrexian Goblins if you have mana available.

222-527-2034-4785.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2034-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

245-1069-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-5295-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1339-1636-6625-6630.description:
Activate Sinister Starfish by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

907-1399-1606-4875.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

5315-5394-6291.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

112-5195-6259.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3769-6085-6086-6087.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
3769-6085-6086-6087.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2781-4617-4906-5913-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
2781-4617-4906-5913-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Pinnacle Monk, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

509-1267-2750-3933.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-2750-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2750-3933.description:
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

918-5016.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Spitemare.
918-5016.description:
Deal damage to Spitemare
Donna Noble and Spitemare trigger.
Resolve the Donna Noble trigger, dealing that much damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Spitemare trigger, dealing that much damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.

350-1636-2519-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
350-1636-2519-2757.description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{W}, allowing you to draw a card whenever a creature enters the battlefield this turn.
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Beck.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Beck trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Llanowar Elves token, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-4013-4404.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
